question:
If it is known that 35 students mentioned momos as their preferred food, on the basis of the information provided in the following pie chart, calculate the number of students who mentioned both rolls and Alu Parathas as their preferred food.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72f876a5b13081e57145a28e689750edbc9767e34c7de896452d2db797c79d0.png]
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72f876a5b13081e57145a28e689750edbc9767e34c7de896452d2db797c79d0.png] 

Number of students mentioned momos as their preferred food = 35

**Concept Used:**

Share of different items = Share of one part × Share of the given item

**Calculation:**

⇒ Fraction share for momos = 0.125

⇒ Number of students for the momos = 35

⇒ Students in the fraction share of momos for 0.1 part = (35)/(0.125)times 0.1 =28

⇒ Fraction share for Rolls = 0.2

⇒ Fraction share for Alu Paranthas = 0.2

⇒ Total fraction part = 0.2 + 0.2 = 0.4

⇒ Students in the total fraction part of rolls and alu paranthas = (28)/(0.1)times 0.4 = 112

**Hence, the total number of students who mentioned either rolls or alu paranthas as their preferred food is 112**
